title: Chapter 203 Large-Scale Annihilation War
content:
Chapter 203 Large-Scale Annihilation War

The soldiers of the evil god camp army, their fighting will comes from the gods they believe in, not the camp, race, territory, family or direct leader.

The soldiers of the evil god camp army with fanatical beliefs can follow the will of the gods they believe in and continue to fight tenaciously even if they lose their commanders.

The middle and low-level officers in the army directly under the spiritual god green department are indeed rich in combat experience. Faced with the loss of high-level commanders, the annihilation of the evil god sacrifice team, the threat of ultra-long-range attacks and flying arms, and the inexplicable rebellion of internal personnel, they can quickly find the most favorable way to break the situation.

They have already understood that under the current situation, it is impossible to retreat unscathed. The only way is to follow the will of the spiritual god and do their best to cause damage to the enemy and make their sacrifice worthwhile.

"We will leave the battle formation! Advance at full speed! Launch an assault on the enemy!"

"Brothers on the left wing are charging! Let's charge too!"

[I hope readers will remember our domain name Taiwan Novel Network →𝔱𝔴𝔨𝔞𝔫.𝔠𝔬𝔪]

Under the command of the surviving officers, the left and right front lines of the Spirit God Green Department's direct army abandoned the ordinary army of the bear goblins, ignored the huge threat of the Zerg flying dragons in the air, and rode on heavy armored ground dragon mounts to charge at the Zerg ground forces.

The distance between the two battle formations was very close. As soon as the Spirit God Green Department's direct army started to charge, their heavy crossbows could shoot at the front line of the Zerg ground forces.

"Maximum range! Free shooting!"

The middle-level officers of the Spirit God Green Department's direct army riding on the back of the heavy armored ground dragon shouted to issue an attack order.

"Maximum range! Free fire!"

"..."

Amid the rumbling explosions, the soldiers of the Spirit God Green Department who heard the order shouted loudly to convey the order.

"Woo woo woo...!"

A large number of crossbows fired by heavy crossbows, with a faint light, drew an arc in the air and shot into the Zerg puppies in the Zerg ground force square.

The crossbows with divine energy easily penetrated the hard shell of the Zerg puppies, causing a large number of casualties to the Zerg puppies.

The Spirit God Green Department's direct army rushed to charge, just to cause the greatest blow to the Zerg army before the various divine arts on them disappeared.

In the charging Spirit God Green Department's direct army, some soldiers' heavy crossbows were not aimed at the Zerg army, but at their companions in front.

This caused many green-armored soldiers who were charging and shooting to be severely injured and fall off their heavy-armored ground dragon mounts.

These soldiers controlled by the Zerg Queen usually only had time to shoot one arrow before the other soldiers around him drew their swords and quickly chopped them to the ground.

"Charge!"

"Charge!"

"..."

The ordinary army of the bear goblin tribe has been suffering huge casualties. Without the protection of the army directly under the Spirit God Green Department, they are lambs to be slaughtered.

There is no room for choice. All the squares of the entire bear goblin army issued an order for the whole army to charge.

Following the army directly under the Spirit God Green Department, they may still be able to play some value. If they continue to march slowly behind, they will be wiped out by the long-range attacks and air strikes of the Zerg.

The army directly under the Spirit God Green Department in the center of the bear goblin army square was blocked by the ordinary army in front and could not rush up. They could only continue to provide air firepower for the army and try their best to stop the rampage of the Zerg flying dragon group.

The Zerg army faced the full charge of the Goblin army. The Zerg puppies in the front took the initiative to attack and rushed towards the Lingshen Green Department's direct army that was rushing up at high speed.

The individual combat power of the Zerg puppies was completely incomparable to the Lingshen Green Department's direct army at this time. They rushed forward to consume the enemy's crossbows and interfere with the enemy's attack on the rear of the Zerg army's square formation!

The main force of the Zerg to attack the Lingshen Green Department's direct army was still more than 5,000 Zerg destroyers.

A round of attack by more than 5,000 star-level Zerg destroyers blew up the momentum of the Lingshen Green Department's direct army.

The Zerg flying dragons in the air also flew towards the Lingshen Green Department's direct army that was rushing in the front, and launched a fierce attack on the enemy who was shooting forward!

The sound of "boom...!" was endless.

Under the ground and air attack of the Zerg destroyers and flying dragons, and the constant harassment of 20 Zerg queens, even the Lingshen Green Department's direct army, which had always maintained its peak combat power, had rapidly reduced its strength and had lost more than half of its troops!

The Lingshen Green Department's direct army in the two phalanxes charging in the front, in such an unfavorable battlefield environment, still fired three rounds of heavy crossbows at the depth of the Zerg ground force phalanx.

In addition to the Zerg puppies, some Zerg hydralisks and cockroaches were also injured!

The one-star hydralisks began to spray Zerg biodegradable liquid into the distance, and their range was enough to reach the forwards of the Lingshen Green Department's direct army that was charging up.

The Zerg puppies finally rushed up and collided with the Lingshen Green Department's direct army that was charging at high speed.

The Zerg puppies could not stop the high-speed charge of the heavy armored ground dragons, and were knocked down one after another!

The green-armored soldiers on the back of the heavy armored ground dragons put down their heavy crossbows, picked up their shields and swords, and raised their hands to slash at the Zerg puppies!

These green-armored soldiers put down their heavy crossbows, picked up melee weapons, and became powerful cavalry!

They have many advantages in equipment, mounts and divine arts. After several combat upgrades, the Zerg puppies can't beat them for a while, allowing them to successfully fight their way out!

But the Zerg puppies are so numerous that they keep jumping into the army directly under the Spirit God Green Department like fleas, suicidal blocking the charge of the green armored cavalry.

Moreover, the Zerg puppies are not fighting alone!

In addition to the bombardment of the Zerg destroyers and the bombing of the Zerg flying dragons, Zerg biological decomposition liquid that can only hurt the enemy fell on their heads, and terrible ground spikes kept emerging from the ground, attacking the heavy armored ground dragons!

The army directly under the Spirit God Green Department, under the three-dimensional attack of the Zerg army, continued to lose personnel, and the force soon dropped to less than 100,000. It was also divided into two parts and surrounded by Zerg puppies.

More Zerg puppies launched a full-scale attack and rushed towards the ordinary army of the bear goblin army.

The charge of more than one million Zerg puppies was really a huge crowd, and the scene was extremely spectacular!

With a large number of Zerg puppies to hold them back, the Zerg dragon group no longer cared about casualties. Nearly 60,000 Zerg dragons risked being shot down and launched close attacks, launching the most intense bombardment against the direct army of the Spirit God Green Department at the forefront.

The essence of the divine blessing of the evil god priests is the use of faith energy. To obtain the corresponding enhancement, you have to pay the corresponding faith energy as a price.

These divine blessings are constantly consumed during continuous attack and defense. Therefore, the highly combat-intensive evil god camp army must be accompanied by evil god priests to replenish divine blessings at any time.

The direct army of the Spirit God Green Department, engaged in such a high-intensity battle, and various divine blessings were quickly consumed.

They are like the interstellar Protoss in the game. After knocking off the outer energy shield, their own defense capabilities are gone.

The soldiers of the Green Spirit Army were even worse, and their attack capabilities were greatly reduced.

The heavy crossbows that relied purely on mechanical kinetic energy had limited damage to the Zerg's strong defensive shells.

The green-armored soldiers' indestructible swords kept slipping when they chopped on the Zerg puppies, and it became difficult to kill the fierce Zerg puppies.

On the fierce battlefield, this sudden change in strength was fatal!

The Zerg flying dragon group suddenly found that the crossbows shot at them had greatly reduced their power and it was difficult to cause fatal damage to them. They all flew over at once, and the flying dragon in the front was about to fly over the enemy's head.

The liquid fireball shells of the Zerg destroyer seemed to have doubled their power. One shell could blow down a large area of green-armored bear goblins and their heavy ground dragon mounts.

Zerg puppies can also hurt green-armored soldiers and heavily-armored ground dragons. Twenty thousand Zerg Hydralisks move forward, and their Zerg biodegradable fluid can also cause great trouble to the enemy.

Zerg stealth spiders lurking underground, their rows of ground spikes can already cause fatal damage to heavily-armored ground dragons.

The soldiers of the Green Spirit Army, they themselves, could not adapt to the sudden reduction in combat power, and instantly went from being unstoppable to being unable to resist, and quickly collapsed.

The speed of attrition increased exponentially. In just a few minutes, except for the thousand or so people who survived under the control of the Zerg Queen and some heavily-armored ground dragon mounts, the 80,000 to 90,000 Green Spirit Army that was surrounded were all killed!

The two Green Spirit Army troops that rushed to the front had more than 100,000 troops when they launched the charge. They only charged less than half the distance before being annihilated by the Zerg army on the way to the charge.

The ordinary army of the bear goblins following the charge was intercepted by countless Zerg puppies. The army directly under the Spirit God Green Department in the middle position continuously fired heavy crossbows at the Zerg puppies that rushed up.

The high-frequency attack consumed all the magic blessings that increased their attack power. It was just an ordinary heavy crossbow, and the damage to the Zerg was very limited.

More than 5,000 Zerg destroyers adjusted their targets and fired a large number of shells at their phalanx.

The fierce artillery attack consumed all the magic blessings on the army directly under the Spirit God Green Department, and the Zerg flying dragon group had already flown over the head of the bear goblin army phalanx.

Zerg cockroaches followed the Zerg puppies and rushed up, the Zerg hydralisk phalanx was also advancing, and the stealth spiders began to move.

A large-scale annihilation war began!

The ordinary army of the bear goblin clan was like lambs to be slaughtered in front of the specially enhanced Zerg army, and was slaughtered quickly and on a large scale.

Without the blessing of the evil god's magic, the army directly under the Green Department of the Spirit God, relying solely on their equipment, is only slightly stronger than the Zerg Zerg. When facing the joint attack of a large number of one-star or above Zerg troops, they are also vulnerable.
